absolute.ayuda: Put a leading / in front of path names

ask-password.ayuda: Allow prompt for password for encrypted configuration

auto-confirm.ayuda: If enabled, do not request console confirmation

backup-dir.ayuda: Make backups into hierarchy based in DIR

backup-dir1.ayuda: --backup-dir for Path1. Must be a non-overlapping path on the same remote.

backup-dir2.ayuda: --backup-dir for Path2. Must be a non-overlapping path on the same remote.

bind.ayuda: Local address to bind to for outgoing connections, IPv4, IPv6 or name

buffer-size.ayuda: In memory buffer size when reading files for each --transfer

bwlimit.ayuda: Bandwidth limit in KiB/s, or use suffix B|K|M|G|T|P or a full timetable

bwlimit-file.ayuda: Bandwidth limit per file in KiB/s, or use suffix B|K|M|G|T|P or a full timetable

ca-cert.ayuda: CA certificate used to verify servers

cache-dir.ayuda: Directory rclone will use for caching

check-access.ayuda: Ensure expected RCLONE_TEST files are found on both Path1 and Path2 filesystems, else abort.

check-first.ayuda: Do all the checks before starting transfers

check-sync.ayuda: Controls comparison of final listings: true|false|only (default: true)

checkers.ayuda: Number of checkers to run in parallel

checksum.ayuda: Check for changes with size & checksum (if available, or fallback to size only)

client-cert.ayuda: Client SSL certificate (PEM) for mutual TLS auth

client-key.ayuda: Client SSL private key (PEM) for mutual TLS auth

client-pass.ayuda: Password for client SSL private key (PEM) for mutual TLS auth (obscured) (obscured)

color.ayuda: When to show colors (and other ANSI codes) AUTO|NEVER|ALWAYS

combined.ayuda: Make a combined report of changes to this file

compare.ayuda: Comma-separated list of bisync-specific compare options ex. 'size,modtime,checksum' (default: 'size,modtime')

compare-dest.ayuda: Include additional server-side paths during comparison

conflict-loser.ayuda: Action to take on the loser of a sync conflict (when there is a winner) or on both files (when there is no winner): , num, pathname, delete (default: num)

conflict-resolve.ayuda: Automatically resolve conflicts by preferring the version that is: none, path1, path2, newer, older, larger, smaller (default: none)

conflict-suffix.ayuda: Suffix to use when renaming a --conflict-loser. Can be either one string or two comma-separated strings to assign different suffixes to Path1/Path2. (default: 'conflict')

copy-dest.ayuda: Implies --compare-dest but also copies files from paths into destination

create-empty-src-dirs.ayuda: Sync creation and deletion of empty directories. (Not compatible with --remove-empty-dirs)

cutoff-mode.ayuda: Mode to stop transfers when reaching the max transfer limit HARD|SOFT|CAUTIOUS

default-time.ayuda: Time to show if modtime is unknown for files and directories

delete-after.ayuda: When synchronizing, delete files on destination after transferring (default)

delete-before.ayuda: When synchronizing, delete files on destination before transferring

delete-during.ayuda: When synchronizing, delete files during transfer

delete-excluded.ayuda: Delete files on dest excluded from sync

dest-after.ayuda: Report all files that exist on the dest post-sync

differ.ayuda: Report all non-matching files to this file

dir-slash.ayuda: Append a slash to directory names

disable.ayuda: Disable a comma separated list of features (use --disable help to see a list)

disable-http-keep-alives.ayuda: Disable HTTP keep-alives and use each connection once

disable-http2.ayuda: Disable HTTP/2 in the global transport

download-hash.ayuda: Compute hash by downloading when otherwise unavailable. (warning: may be slow and use lots of data!)

dry-run.ayuda: Do a trial run with no permanent changes

dscp.ayuda: Set DSCP value to connections, value or name, e.g. CS1, LE, DF, AF21

dump.ayuda: List of items to dump from: headers, bodies, requests, responses, auth, filters, goroutines, openfiles, mapper, curl, errors, trace

dump-bodies.ayuda: Dump HTTP headers and bodies - may contain sensitive info

dump-headers.ayuda: Dump HTTP headers - may contain sensitive info

error.ayuda: Report all files with errors (hashing or reading) to this file

error-on-no-transfer.ayuda: Sets exit code 9 if no files are transferred, useful in scripts

exclude-from.ayuda: Read file exclude patterns from file (use - to read from stdin)

exclude-if-present.ayuda: Exclude directories if filename is present

expect-continue-timeout.ayuda: Timeout when using expect / 100-continue in HTTP

fast-list.ayuda: Use recursive list if available; uses more memory but fewer transactions

files-from.ayuda: Read list of source-file names from file (use - to read from stdin)

files-from-raw.ayuda: Read list of source-file names from file without any processing of lines (use - to read from stdin)

files-from0.ayuda: Read list of source-file names from file using NUL as separator (use - to read from stdin)

filter-from.ayuda: Read file filtering patterns from a file (use - to read from stdin)

filters-file.ayuda: Read filtering patterns from a file

fix-case.ayuda: Force rename of case insensitive dest to match source

force.ayuda: Bypass --max-delete safety check and run the sync. Consider using with --verbose

format.ayuda: Output format - see lsf help for details

fs-cache-expire-duration.ayuda: Cache remotes for this long (0 to disable caching)

fs-cache-expire-interval.ayuda: Interval to check for expired remotes

hash.ayuda: Use this hash when h is used in the format MD5|SHA-1|DropboxHash

hash-filter.ayuda: Partition filenames by hash k/n or randomly @/n

header.ayuda: Set HTTP header for all transactions

header-download.ayuda: Set HTTP header for download transactions

header-upload.ayuda: Set HTTP header for upload transactions

human-readable.ayuda: Print numbers in a human-readable format, sizes with suffix Ki|Mi|Gi|Ti|Pi

ignore-checksum.ayuda: Skip post copy check of checksums

ignore-errors.ayuda: Delete even if there are I/O errors

ignore-existing.ayuda: Skip all files that exist on destination

ignore-listing-checksum.ayuda: Do not use checksums for listings (add --ignore-checksum to additionally skip post-copy checksum checks)

ignore-size.ayuda: Ignore size when skipping use modtime or checksum

ignore-times.ayuda: Don't skip items that match size and time - transfer all unconditionally

immutable.ayuda: Do not modify files, fail if existing files have been modified

include-from.ayuda: Read file include patterns from file (use - to read from stdin)

inplace.ayuda: Download directly to destination file instead of atomic download to temp/rename

kv-lock-time.ayuda: Maximum time to keep key-value database locked by process

links.ayuda: Translate symlinks to/from regular files with a '.rclonelink' extension

list-cutoff.ayuda: To save memory, sort directory listings on disk above this threshold

log-file-compress.ayuda: If set, compress rotated log files using gzip

log-file-max-age.ayuda: Maximum duration to retain old log files (eg "7d")

log-file-max-backups.ayuda: Maximum number of old log files to retain

log-file-max-size.ayuda: Maximum size of the log file before it's rotated (eg "10M")

log-format.ayuda: Comma separated list of log format options

log-systemd.ayuda: Activate systemd integration for the logger

low-level-retries.ayuda: Number of low level retries to do

match.ayuda: Report all matching files to this file

max-age.ayuda: Only transfer files younger than this in s or suffix ms|s|m|h|d|w|M|y

max-backlog.ayuda: Maximum number of objects in sync or check backlog

max-buffer-memory.ayuda: If set, don't allocate more than this amount of memory as buffers

max-connections.ayuda: Maximum number of simultaneous backend API connections, 0 for unlimited

max-delete.ayuda: When synchronizing, limit the number of deletes

max-delete-size.ayuda: When synchronizing, limit the total size of deletes

max-depth.ayuda: If set limits the recursion depth to this

max-duration.ayuda: Maximum duration rclone will transfer data for

max-lock.ayuda: Consider lock files older than this to be expired (default: 0 (never expire)) (minimum: 2m)

max-size.ayuda: Only transfer files smaller than this in KiB or suffix B|K|M|G|T|P

max-stats-groups.ayuda: Maximum number of stats groups to keep in memory, on max oldest is discarded

max-transfer.ayuda: Maximum size of data to transfer

metadata.ayuda: If set, preserve metadata when copying objects

metadata-exclude-from.ayuda: Read metadata exclude patterns from file (use - to read from stdin)

metadata-filter-from.ayuda: Read metadata filtering patterns from a file (use - to read from stdin)

metadata-include-from.ayuda: Read metadata include patterns from file (use - to read from stdin)

metadata-mapper.ayuda: Program to run to transforming metadata before upload

min-age.ayuda: Only transfer files older than this in s or suffix ms|s|m|h|d|w|M|y

min-size.ayuda: Only transfer files bigger than this in KiB or suffix B|K|M|G|T|P

missing-on-dst.ayuda: Report all files missing from the destination to this file

missing-on-src.ayuda: Report all files missing from the source to this file

modify-window.ayuda: Max time diff to be considered the same

multi-thread-chunk-size.ayuda: Chunk size for multi-thread downloads / uploads, if not set by filesystem

multi-thread-cutoff.ayuda: Use multi-thread downloads for files above this size

multi-thread-streams.ayuda: Number of streams to use for multi-thread downloads

multi-thread-write-buffer-size.ayuda: In memory buffer size for writing when in multi-thread mode

name-transform.ayuda: Transform paths during the copy process

no-check-certificate.ayuda: Do not verify the server SSL certificate (insecure)

no-check-dest.ayuda: Don't check the destination, copy regardless

no-cleanup.ayuda: Retain working files (useful for troubleshooting and testing).

no-console.ayuda: Hide console window (supported on Windows only)

no-slow-hash.ayuda: Ignore listing checksums only on backends where they are slow

no-traverse.ayuda: Don't traverse destination file system on copy

no-unicode-normalization.ayuda: Don't normalize unicode characters in filenames

no-update-modtime.ayuda: Don't update destination modtime if files identical

order-by.ayuda: Instructions on how to order the transfers, e.g. 'size,descending'

partial-suffix.ayuda: Add partial-suffix to temporary file name when --inplace is not used

password-command.ayuda: Command for supplying password for encrypted configuration

progress-terminal-title.ayuda: Show progress on the terminal title (requires -P/--progress)

quiet.ayuda: Print as little stuff as possible

recover.ayuda: Automatically recover from interruptions without requiring --resync.

refresh-times.ayuda: Refresh the modtime of remote files

remove-empty-dirs.ayuda: Remove ALL empty directories at the final cleanup step.

resilient.ayuda: Allow future runs to retry after certain less-serious errors, instead of requiring --resync.

resync.ayuda: Performs the resync run. Equivalent to --resync-mode path1. Consider using --verbose or --dry-run first.

resync-mode.ayuda: During resync, prefer the version that is: path1, path2, newer, older, larger, smaller (default: path1 if --resync, otherwise none for no resync.)

retries.ayuda: Retry operations this many times if they fail

retries-sleep.ayuda: Interval between retrying operations if they fail, e.g. 500ms, 60s, 5m (0 to disable)

separator.ayuda: Separator for the items in the format

server-side-across-configs.ayuda: Allow server-side operations (e.g. copy) to work across different configs

size-only.ayuda: Skip based on size only, not modtime or checksum

slow-hash-sync-only.ayuda: Ignore slow checksums for listings and deltas, but still consider them during sync calls.

stats.ayuda: Interval between printing stats, e.g. 500ms, 60s, 5m (0 to disable)

stats-file-name-length.ayuda: Max file name length in stats (0 for no limit)

stats-log-level.ayuda: Log level to show --stats output DEBUG|INFO|NOTICE|ERROR

stats-one-line.ayuda: Make the stats fit on one line

stats-one-line-date.ayuda: Enable --stats-one-line and add current date/time prefix

stats-one-line-date-format.ayuda: Enable --stats-one-line-date and use custom formatted date: Enclose date string in double quotes ("), see https://golang.org/pkg/time/#Time.Format

stats-unit.ayuda: Show data rate in stats as either 'bits' or 'bytes' per second

streaming-upload-cutoff.ayuda: Cutoff for switching to chunked upload if file size is unknown, upload starts after reaching cutoff or when file ends

suffix.ayuda: Suffix to add to changed files

temp-dir.ayuda: Directory rclone will use for temporary files

timeformat.ayuda: Specify a custom time format - see docs for details (default: 2006-01-02 15:04:05)

tpslimit.ayuda: Limit HTTP transactions per second to this

track-renames.ayuda: When synchronizing, track file renames and do a server-side move if possible

track-renames-strategy.ayuda: Strategies to use when synchronizing using track-renames hash|modtime|leaf

transfers.ayuda: Number of file transfers to run in parallel

update.ayuda: Skip files that are newer on the destination

use-server-modtime.ayuda: Use server modified time instead of object metadata

user-agent.ayuda: Set the user-agent to a specified string

verbose.ayuda: Print lots more stuff (repeat for more)

workdir.ayuda: Use custom working dir - useful for testing.
